info.description: Code-derived development contract through upstream main 8a5fe58 (PR #14 common errors, PR #15 package organization, PR #19 Flyway database migration). PR #19 changes database startup, not these HTTP shapes. AI draft is a proposal only; execution is a local quote-policy/evidence fixture. The F012-F014 Java merchant proposal has no HTTP route. Email/JWT authentication and optional wallet-signature login are exposed; payment, fulfillment and real-user acceptance are not. Outside the mapped F010 draft envelope, unknown paths map to 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND; unsupported methods map to 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with Allow. Recognized Spring argument conversion maps to 400 INVALID_INPUT. Issue #34/#35 adds the /api/v1/tasks Task/Mandate, local pharmacy quote, deterministic policy, EIP-712 approval and idempotent order surface (no payment).

get.description: Applies lazy expiry (AWAITING_APPROVAL/ACTIVE → EXPIRED when mandate.expiresAt passed).

post.description: Previous version → REVOKED; un-ordered attempts → SUPERSEDED; ACTIVE → AWAITING_APPROVAL. Signatures for older versions cannot be reused.

Collects local pharmacy simulator quotes for the mandate item, or returns unexpired snapshots (same quoteId). recipientAddress is the server registry mapping; quotedPayToAddress is untrusted merchant data kept as evidence.

get.description: Field-for-field match of aiproposal.MerchantProposal.Context/Quote. mandateState=ACTIVE means proposals are accepted (task AWAITING_APPROVAL, mandate DRAFT, not expired).

post.description: Records an attempt with policy ALLOW or DENY. DENY does not end the task unless 5 attempts are reached or every live quote was denied (→ DECLINED / NO_VALID_CANDIDATE).
Only for POLICY_ALLOWED attempts. Server fills every signed field and a single-use bytes32 nonce. An open request is returned again.

Recomputes the digest from stored facts, recovers the signer, requires a wallet linked to the task owner, revalidates mandate/quote/recipient/budget, then consumes the nonce once. Mandate → CONFIRMED, task → ACTIVE.
AWAITING_APPROVAL → DECLINED (USER_REJECTED). Optional body {"reason"} is not stored.
ACTIVE/EXECUTING → CANCELLED (USER_CANCELLED). Existing orders are not reported as reversed.
Requires task ACTIVE and an APPROVED attempt. Revalidates before ordering. Creates a merchant order only; paymentStatus stays NOT_ATTEMPTED. Task → EXECUTING.
